cluster_stories.summary: Jakub Pachocki just posted a new proposal for how to set limits on training future AI systems:Given that the main way new surprising capabilities emerge is by progress on compression, a measure rooted in perplexity could give us a shared benchmark for general intelligence, regardless of the degree of automation of the development process. Extrapolating from recent progress, we should expect further transformative capabilities as we enter the ~0.68-0.7 log-perplexity window. I don’t know what those capabilities will be, and we may not be testing for them today. At the same time, we should also expect further degradation⁠(opens in a new window) in currently dominant forms of alignment auditing and further increases in evaluation and training awareness.
